description: 依据E36已存提案事前登记有限24月原因核对；完整程序保存，原源码不修改。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_purchase_adjustment_current_report_cause_review_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
assert not OUT.exists(),'本有限问题已登记，不重复执行。'
OUT.mkdir()
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ref='reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1'
parents=[
ref+'/next_experiment.json',ref+'/protocol_source.json',ref+'/protocol.json',ref+'/source_gate.json',ref+'/result.json',
ref+'/全部132月采购原文绑定.json',ref+'/原公布采购月度字段.parquet',ref+'/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet',
ref+'/每日采购条件评分.csv',ref+'/固定失败归因_信号费用与账户边界.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_index_domestic_constraint_clock_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_index_domestic_constraint_clock_v1/result.json',
'research/historical_index_domestic_constraint_clock_v1.py']
records=json.loads((ROOT/(ref+'/全部132月采购原文绑定.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
selected=[r for r in records if '2024-01'<=r['stat_month']<='2025-12']
assert len(selected)==24
raws=[]
for r in selected:
 p=ROOT/r['raw_path'];assert sha(p)==r['raw_sha256']
 raws.append({'stat_month':r['stat_month'],'path':r['raw_path'],'sha256':r['raw_sha256'],'source_url':r['source_url'],'published_at':r['published_at'],'available_at':r['available_at']})
proto={
'study_id':'510300_PURCHASE_ADJUSTMENT_CURRENT_REPORT_CAUSE_REVIEW_V1','experiment_id':'E37','registered_at':now(),
'question':'2024—2025全部24统计月采购量扩散指数调整，原官方当月正文是否直接解释需求、备料/库存、成本或交付原因？',
'prior_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E35_MONTHLY_SOURCE_IDENTITY_AND_E36_ACTUAL_FIXED_INCREMENT_REJECTION_WITH_COST_DIAGNOSIS',
'parents':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p),'bytes':(ROOT/p).stat().st_size} for p in parents],'raw_reports':raws,
'fixed_months':['2024-01','2025-12'],'expected_stat_months':[r['stat_month'] for r in selected],
'field_plan':{'original_purchase':['采购量水平','采购量月度变化'],'context_current_month_only':['生产','新订单','原材料库存','供应商配送时间','主要原材料购进价格','出厂价格','产成品库存'],'context_change':'只能用本24月内相邻统计月差；第一个月相邻背景变化未知，不扩大原文预算补值。'},
'official_text_scope':'仅当月报告正文，排除表格/导航/脚本；保存全部正文段落及采购主题定位句，人工核全部24月。只数字解释不能算驱动原因。',
'direct_cause_requirement':'原文明确以采购/备料行为调整为被解释对象并说明原因；一般制造业需求/生产/库存/价格同期变化只记竞争解释线索。原因缺失UNKNOWN，多解释不能定主因MIXED。',
'quantity_measure_limits':'不同问项扩散指标没有实际采购数量/现金流恒等式；采购指数上升与高于50分别记录，不把指数上升当实际采购总量增长。',
'score_time_pair':'复用原E36首次进入新统计月的保存决定日及前一保存日，仅读score/pred/path/时点，排除未来收益列。跨日同时含订单、日行情和成熟池变化，不将分数差归为采购因果效应。',
'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'evidence_class':'当月原网页的后来保存重构，有限历史解释；未认证首次收件/不可变首版。',
'budget':{'raw_report_months':24,'new_network_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0},
'stop':'完成24月全文/当期原行与时点线索即结束，不新增字段组合/阈值/时期/模型、收益分组或新账户。',
'preserve':'E36固定五门/拒绝、E35不同总体源门、DR暂缺有效访问与E34条件接续全部保持。',
'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False}
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E37':'24月有限原因核对已登记','新网络请求':0,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'原源码':'不修改'},ensure_ascii=False))
